entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to start a return for an order I placed about a month ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It was for a pair of mountain bike shoes.

Okay, I see the order. The VeloFit All-Terrain Mountain Bike Shoes. Just to understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's a fit issue. I've taken these cycling shoes out a few times, and they just don't feel right. The way my cleats attach seems to create a pressure point, and I'm starting to get blisters on longer rides.

I'm sorry to hear they're not working out and are causing blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the delivery date here... okay, it looks like they were delivered 28 days ago.
That sounds about right. So, can I get a refund?

Absolutely. You are well within our 90-day return window. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Once we receive the shoes, we'll process your full refund.

Great, thanks for making that easy. Since I did try them out and now have to go through the hassle of packing and shipping them back, is there any way you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase? I'd like to try a different model.

I understand the request, but our policy is to provide a full refund for the item, which covers the return. I'm not authorized to issue a promotional discount on top of the approved refund. However, the new model you're interested in will be waiting for you once your refund is processed.
Okay, I thought I'd ask. A full refund is fine. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. You should see that email with the return label in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
